content: ADK AgentTool wraps a BaseAgent as a callable tool. Import: from google.adk.tools.agent_tool import AgentTool. Constructor: AgentTool(agent=my_agent, skip_summarization=False). Include in parent agent tools=[AgentTool(agent=cleaning_agent)]. When parent LLM calls the tool, ADK runs the wrapped agent, captures response, forwards state/artifacts back. Verified import path in installed google-adk 2.3.0.
